1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
8:   // ----- Audio -----
9:   const jumpSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA');
10:   const hitSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAAAA');
11:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
12: 
13:   // ----- Graphics helpers -----
14:   function drawBackground() {
15:     // Sky gradient
16:     const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height * 0.6);
17:     sky.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
18:     sky.addColorStop(1, '#B0E0E6');
19:     ctx.fillStyle = sky;
20:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height * 0.6);
21:     // Ground
22:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
23:     ctx.fillRect(0, height * 0.8, width, height * 0.2);
24:   }
25: 
26:   // Simple cloud class for parallax effect
27:   const clouds = [];
28:   function spawnCloud() {
29:     const cw = 60 + Math.random() * 40;
30:     const ch = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
31:     clouds.push({ x: width, y: Math.random() * height * 0.4, w: cw, h: ch, speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5 });
32:   }
33:   function updateClouds() {
34:     for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
35:       const c = clouds[i];
36:       c.x -= c.speed;
37:       if (c.x + c.w < 0) clouds.splice(i, 1);
38:     }
39:     if (Math.random() < 0.01) spawnCloud();
40:   }
41:   function drawClouds() {
42:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
43:     clouds.forEach(c => ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h));
44:   }
45: 
46:   const player = {
47:     x: 50,
48:     y: height - 30,
49:     w: 20,
50:     h: 30,
51:     vy: 0,
52:     jumpStrength: -8,
53:     onGround: true,
54:     draw() {
55:       // Rounded rectangle with gradient
56:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x, this.y + this.h);
57:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#4CAF50');
58:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#2E7D32');
59:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
60:       ctx.beginPath();
61:       ctx.moveTo(this.x + 5, this.y);
62:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w - 5, this.y);
63:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.w, this.y, this.x + this.w, this.y + 5);
64:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h - 5);
65:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h, this.x + this.w - 5, this.y + this.h);
66:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + 5, this.y + this.h);
67:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y + this.h, this.x, this.y + this.h - 5);
68:       ctx.lineTo(this.x, this.y + 5);
69:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y, this.x + 5, this.y);
70:       ctx.closePath();
71:       ctx.fill();
72:     },
73:     update() {
74:       this.vy += 0.4; // gravity
75:       this.y += this.vy;
76:       if (this.y + this.h >= height * 0.8) {
77:         this.y = height * 0.8 - this.h;
78:         this.vy = 0;
79:         this.onGround = true;
80:       } else {
81:         this.onGround = false;
82:       }
83:     },
84:     jump() { if (this.onGround) { this.vy = this.jumpStrength; this.onGround = false; jumpSound.play(); } }
85:   };
86: 
87:   // obstacles: simple rectangles moving left with gradient shading
88:   const obstacles = [];
89:   let obstacleTimer = 0;
90:   const obstacleInterval = 120; // frames
91:   let score = 0;
92:   let gameOver = false;
93: 
94:   function spawnObstacle() {
95:     const w = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
96:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 40;
97:     obstacles.push({ x: width, y: height * 0.8 - h, w, h, passed: false });
98:   }
99: 
100:   function updateObstacles() {
101:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
102:       const o = obstacles[i];
103:       o.x -= 3; // speed
104:       // collision
105:       if (!gameOver &&
106:           player.x < o.x + o.w &&
107:           player.x + player.w > o.x &&
108:           player.y < o.y + o.h &&
109:           player.y + player.h > o.y) {
110:         gameOver = true; hitSound.play();
111:       }
112:       // remove off‑screen
113:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
114:     }
115:   }
116: 
117:   function drawObstacles() {
118:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
119:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x, o.y + o.h);
120:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#D32F2F');
121:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#7B241C');
122:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
123:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
124:     });
125:   }
126: 
127:   function drawScore() {
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
129:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
130:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
131:   }
132: 
133:   function loop() {
134:     if (gameOver) {
135:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
136:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
137:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
138:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
139:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
140:       return;
141:     }
142:     // Draw background and clouds first
143:     drawBackground();
144:     updateClouds();
145:     drawClouds();
146:     // Game entities
147:     player.update();
148:     player.draw();
149:     obstacleTimer++;
150:     if (obstacleTimer > obstacleInterval) { spawnObstacle(); obstacleTimer = 0; }
151:     updateObstacles();
152:     drawObstacles();
153:     score++;
154:     drawScore();
155:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
156:   }
157: 
158:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => player.jump());
159:   // also support touch
160:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); player.jump(); });
161: 
162:   loop();
163: })();

(End of file - total 163 lines)
</content>
